title: docs(pm-dispatch): retire duty-7's reader half per maintainer ruling
body:
Fixes #13304

Retires duty ⑦'s **reader half** from `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`, executing the maintainer ruling.

## The ruling

Maintainer ruling 2026-08-31 (chat), verbatim:

> 「13580 B(荐」

Option **B** as put to the maintainer, verbatim from the ruling comment on the card:

> **B (recommended)** — retire duty ⑦'s reader half outright: the 读者半边 and 正对照 bullets of the runbook's ⑦ section. The instrument is measured structurally blind on 104 of 121 keys; text explaining when to trust a blind instrument helps no PM decision. Construct removal, net-negative lines. The surface half (canonical diff, measured good) stays.

The ruling also settles what does **not** land here, verbatim:

> The 同类 family's transferable sentence (grading comment above) does NOT get a replacement carrier in the runbook — under this ruling, fewer methodology sentences is the point.

Accordingly this diff adds **zero replacement prose**. PR #13580 (the earlier +7-line applicability-domain repair on this card) was stood down unmerged and is superseded by this one; none of its text is imported here.

## The diff

One file, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`. **271 → 265 lines** (1 insertion, 7 deletions).

Deleted — the two bullets carrying the reader-count method:

- the **读者半边** bullet (3 lines): the per-key `git grep` recipe plus its three hit-adjudication rules.
- the **正对照恒先跑** bullet (3 lines): the `sys_share_link.email_allowlist` calibration control.

Kept, untouched — the section heading and the **surface half** bullet (canonical member-level diff, measured good), including its pinned baseline ref.

### The one coherence repair

The heading suffix 「与校准」 ("and calibration") named the calibration bullet that this PR deletes, so leaving it would have made the heading actively false. It is dropped in place, word-level, no re-wrap:

`## security-object 无判决枚举(座位贴常设 ⑦)的方法与校准` → `## security-object 无判决枚举(座位贴常设 ⑦)的方法`

Measured: that line goes **73 → 64 bytes** — it shrinks, so it is byte-bounded in the sense the in-passage word-tightening rounds on this file established (#13427, #13403, #13505 are cited here as precedent for the shape of an in-passage tightening, not as a standing permission — the authority for this edit is the ruling above).

**A second rename was considered and rejected on measurement.** Renaming the surviving bullet 「表面半边」 ("surface half") — whose name still references a two-half structure that no longer exists — to 「成员级 diff」 would take its line from **116 → 118 bytes**, i.e. it *grows*. Under the byte-bound it is therefore not taken: the words stay as-is and the residual naming incoherence is left for the corpus-audit card's Phase 3 to fold in.

## Verification

### Acceptance table, evaluated at BOTH refs via `git show REF:path`

Base `d47583841` (merge base) vs head `0a424c942`:

| check | at base | at head | expected | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| negative anchor: 读者半边 | 1 | 0 | 1 → 0 | PASS |
| negative anchor: 正对照恒先跑 | 1 | 0 | 1 → 0 | PASS |
| negative anchor: `sys_share_link.email_allowlist` | 1 | 0 | 1 → 0 | PASS |
| negative anchor: heading suffix 与校准 | 1 | 0 | 1 → 0 | PASS |
| POSITIVE control: 表面半边 survives | 1 | 1 | 1 → 1 | PASS |
| POSITIVE control: section heading survives | 1 | 1 | 1 → 1 | PASS |
| POSITIVE control: pinned baseline ref `b000ab59` survives | 1 | 1 | 1 → 1 | PASS |
| line count | 271 | 265 | 271 → 265 | PASS |

The positive-control rows are load-bearing, not decoration: a zero on those would mean the instrument broke rather than that the text is gone. All three read 1 at head, so the negative-anchor zeros above them are measurements and not instrument failure.

**Repo-wide sweep:** `git grep -n 读者半边` and `git grep -n 正对照恒先跑` over the whole tree return **no hits** after this change — the runbook was the only carrier, so no other file needs a follow-up and none was edited.

### Why no ablation applies

The ratchet is a **ceiling** (an upper bound on line count), and this diff only removes lines. A deletion cannot breach an upper bound, so there is no red to predict and no mutation that would produce one — an ablation here would have no failing leg to demonstrate. The reverse verification that *is* meaningful for a pure deletion is the two-ref acceptance table above, which is why that is what was run.

### Gates

Family derived from the ACTUAL diff with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (7 families; the script derived the change set itself from the merge base). All 7 run and green at head `0a424c942`. Each gate's own verdict line:

- `check:agent-test-spelling` — `✓ check-agent-test-spelling: 0 violations — 413 file(s) · 5084 bare -- token(s) · 1284 launcher-rooted run(s) · 9 separator(s) JUDGED · 5 vitest-backed script name(s) derived from 80 manifest(s)`
- `check:doc-authoring` — `✓ doc authoring guard: 393 files clean — no bare metadata literals.` and `✓ doc authoring guard: 48 published skill files clean — no internal issue-id references.`
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` — `✓ check:doc-formula-expressions: 22 record-scoped formula example(s) across 426 files / 1451 TS blocks judged clean by @objectstack/formula.`
- `check:pm-governed-merges` — `✓ check-governed-merges --self-test: 228 assertions`
- `check:pm-skill-id-lint` — `✓ check-skill-id-lint: 23 file(s) clean (pattern /#[0-9]{3,}/g).`
- `check:pm-skill-ratchet` — `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md is 265 lines (ceiling 278; headroom 13).`
- `check:skill-frame-sync` — `✓ check-skill-frame-sync: 4 copies of the decision frame are structurally isomorphic across 3 files`

Two of the seven first reported `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` in the fresh worktree and were treated as NOT MEASURED rather than as failures, per each gate's own text: `check:doc-authoring` named `pnpm install`, and `check:doc-formula-expressions` named `pnpm install` then two builds (`@objectstack/formula`, then `@objectstack/lint`). Each prerequisite was satisfied and the gate re-run; the green lines quoted above are from those re-runs. Every exit code was captured directly (`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`), never through a pipe.

The **ratchet pin is deliberately not followed down** (278 → 265) in this PR: `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is serial behind another in-flight chain, and the pin follow-down is deferred to the corpus audit's Phase 3 per the ruling. The ceiling is an upper bound, so 265 ≤ 278 passes it untouched — as the quoted verdict line shows, with headroom 13.

## Posture

- **Governed surface** (`.claude/**`): this PR stays **draft**. No ready flip, no auto-merge, no review submitted — landing is the maintainer's call.
- **`skip-changeset`**: applied. The diff publishes nothing from any package — it is confined to `.claude/**`.
- Control-character self-scan over the edited file: clean, zero hits.
